remarks: Welcome to luxury mid-rise living, yet with a neighborhood feel, in the gorgeous waterfront Maritime building, close to restaurants, shops, the train and more! This stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom waterfront corner unit with balcony has views from every single floor-to-ceiling window, complete with custom window treatments! Natural light and nature's beauty envelope you while enjoying modern living both in this unit and the building's resident amenities. Gleaming and updated bamboo hardwood flooring and recessed lighting runs throughout the open concept layout and bedrooms. Both full bathrooms boast custom Porcelanosa tile with a sleek design. The kitchen is the heart of the space with solid-wood cabinets, granite countertops, and a 10ft island with seating! The primary bedroom features a walk-in-closet with custom California closet inserts and the second bedroom has two great-size closets for storage! Most appliances have been updated in the last few years including an oversized washer and dryer, and the HVAC system was replaced! This unit boasts MANY updates that others do not have. Two parking spaces are included, one in the private lot outside and one in the parking garage. Building amenities include a fitness center, meeting room, lounge with fireplace, pool table, TV and abundant seating. There are many opportunities for outdoor enjoyment-from kayaking and paddle boarding to sunset strolls along the harbor. Come experience elevated living in Downtown SoNo!
